## Goal
The report (WO-299) needs the earliest fresh scan to compare with the newest. Scan history is read with `_scan_events(store, profile_id, limit=5000)` (`engine/exposure.py:734-735`), which asks the store for the newest 5000 events of ALL kinds for that person and keeps the exposure scans. With a 400-site registry one scan writes about 400 `exposure_check` events (`exposure.py:686-692`) plus one scan event, so 5000 rows cover about 12 scans: the "first" scan silently becomes "the oldest of the last dozen". Add `first_and_latest_scan(store, profile, registry=None) -> ScanPair` (frozen dataclass: `first`, `latest` as `ExposureResult | None`, and `history_complete: bool`). It skips offline scans (they only re-read stored data, as `exposure_trend` does, `exposure.py:868-883`). `history_complete` is False when the event read returned exactly the limit (the oldest rows may have been cut off), so the report can say "since the earliest scan we have on record".

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. No scans: `ScanPair(None, None, True)`. One fresh scan: `first == latest`, complete.
2. Three fresh scans plus an offline scan between them: the offline one is never `first` or `latest`.
3. With a fake store whose `events` returns exactly `limit` rows, `history_complete` is False; with fewer rows it is True.
4. `latest` equals `latest_exposure(...)` when the newest scan is not offline.
5. A scan event with a wrong `version` or broken detail is skipped, never raises (same tolerance as `_from_event`, `exposure.py:738-780`).
6. Only reads: no store writes, no network.
7. Existing exposure, trend and WO-295 tests pass unchanged.

This is Codex code-lane work (owner, 2026-11-09): fix and improve the listed module(s) directly, with tests; don't xfail a bug you can fix here. No contract changes: public function signatures, `src/freemyid/models.py`, `interfaces.py`, schema files, `--json` shapes and documented CLI output stay as they are (additive helpers inside the listed files are fine). If the work turns out to need a contract change, stop and say so in VENDOR_STATUS.md "Questions for the owner". Fake data only, offline (fake fetchers, no network), Windows-safe paths in tests (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`, no `/tmp`). Typed, ruff-clean, small diff. Line numbers are from main at the time of writing (2026-11-09); re-check them.

WO-279 (blocked, same file) is not a prerequisite: if in-house unblocks WO-279 first, in-house gives it an order line after this WO (and the other queued WOs on `engine/exposure.py`) so the two never edit the file at once.
